no shutdown.explanation: 启用接口（默认情况下接口是关闭的）

encapsulation dot1q 100.explanation: 配置接口的封装类型为dot1q，VLAN ID为100

mpls traffic-eng tunnel-id 1.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的ID为1

mpls traffic-eng tunnel destination 2.2..explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的目的地址为2.2.2.2

mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label proto.template: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label protocol [parameter1]
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label proto.command: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label protocol ldp
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label proto.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的标签协议为LDP

mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label tlv.template: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label tlv
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label tlv.command: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label tlv
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label tlv.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的标签TLV

mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack.template: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack.command: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的标签栈

mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack.template: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack depth [parameter1]
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack.command: mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack depth 1
mpls traffic-eng tunnel mpls label stack.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程隧道的标签栈深度为1
